ic_name: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol (ARM IHI 0051, Single Unidirectional Stream Channel)
opcode_synthesis_skipped_reason: L2.protocol_overview.half_duplex is not True and no explicit opcode/command-table heading was found in input/docs/. Free-form hex bytes in prose, SVG labels, or PDF text do not constitute opcode evidence.
protocol_type: Unidirectional single-channel stream transfer protocol. The master (source) drives TVALID + TDATA + qualifiers (TSTRB/TKEEP/TLAST/TID/TDEST/TUSER); the slave (sink) drives TREADY. A transfer moves one beat when both TVALID and TREADY are HIGH on a rising ACLK edge. There is no address, no read/write command, and no response channel.

channels.name: AXI4-Stream channel (the only channel)
channels.description: Master drives TVALID/TDATA/TSTRB/TKEEP/TLAST/TID/TDEST/TUSER; slave drives TREADY. One beat transfers when TVALID and TREADY are both HIGH on a rising ACLK edge.

interface_signals.ACLK: global; single clock, all signals sampled on its rising edge
interface_signals.ARESETn: global; active-LOW reset; TVALID driven LOW during reset
interface_signals.TVALID: master->slave; master is driving a valid transfer
interface_signals.TREADY: slave->master; slave can accept a transfer this cycle
interface_signals.TDATA: master->slave; payload, TDATA_WIDTH a multiple of 8
interface_signals.TLAST: master->slave; last transfer of a packet

transfer_types.name: Single transfer
transfer_types.description: One beat of TDATA + qualifiers moves when TVALID and TREADY are both HIGH on a rising ACLK edge.

transfer_types.name: Continuous (fully-packed) stream
transfer_types.description: Back-to-back transfers where every byte is a data byte (TKEEP=1, TSTRB=1).

transfer_types.name: Sparse / partially-packed stream
transfer_types.description: Stream using position bytes (TKEEP=1,TSTRB=0) and null bytes (TKEEP=0,TSTRB=0) to preserve layout and pad partial beats.

transfer_types.name: Packet (TLAST-delimited)
transfer_types.description: One or more transfers ended by TLAST HIGH on the last beat; unframed streams are one indefinitely long packet.

transfer_types.name: Routed / multiplexed stream
transfer_types.description: TID identifies the stream and TDEST selects the destination; interconnect routes and orders streams sharing a channel.

addressing.note: AXI4-Stream is ADDRESSLESS — there is no address phase and no read/write transaction. This is the key structural difference from the memory-mapped AMBA AXI protocol. Routing (not addressing) is provided by TID (stream id) and TDEST (destination).
addressing.routing: TID identifies a stream; TDEST selects a destination port.

arbitration_note: An AXI4-Stream interconnect (switch/multiplexer) arbitrates between multiple input streams contending for a shared output, routing by TDEST and preserving per-TID ordering; the base point-to-point interface itself has no arbitration.
